title: extract_response: args.clone() — use &Value as Deserializer instead
description: client.rs:544: serde_json::from_value(args.clone()) — args is &serde_json::Value but from_value takes ownership, forcing a deep clone. serde_json implements Deserializer<'de> for &'de Value, so T::deserialize(args).map_err(ClientError::Parse) works for T: DeserializeOwned without any allocation. This clone is gratuitous — it exists because from_value was reached for first, not because independent ownership is required.
